explanation: Read-only SQL over the verified BDC panel.
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN period_role = 'prior' THEN fair_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS prior_fair_value, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN period_role = 'current' THEN fair_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS current_fair_value, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN period_role = 'current' THEN fair_value ELSE -fair_value END), 2) AS change_usd FROM holdings
